summary: McLaren hunts Mercedes in the championship fight as George Russell starts from the back of the grid following his power-unit penalty, scrambling the usual pecking order under Singapore's brutal night-race conditions. The sweltering heat-hazard designation—the fourth this season—forces teams into aggressive pit strategies and tire management on the Marina Bay circuit's 23 corners, where undercut gambles and safety-car timing could reshape positions faster than qualifying pace predicts. A strong result here for McLaren tightens their title push against a compromised Mercedes lineup, making this the season's sixth and final sprint event a potential championship momentum-shifter.
